newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's IRI to continue Stet talks.
newsitem.headline: Italy's IRI to continue Stet talks.

text.p: Shareholders at Italian state holding IRI will meet by early next week to approve the transition of telecommunications group STET to the Treasury, an IRI board member said.
Shareholders met on Tuesday but failed to complete all the business on the agenda, which also included proposals to merge STET with telephone operating company, Telecom Italia.
"The meeting remains open. We'll meet again next Thursday or Monday," IRI board member Antonio Urciuoli told reporters as he came out of the assembly.

The shareholders have to decide what price the Treasury must pay for IRI's 61.27 percent holding of Stet's ordinary capital and its 0.93 percent holding of the firm's saving shares. The book value is put at 11.2 trillion lire.
